volcano: Volcano plot for cluster cl_aug_1. 25 of 100 genes significant at FDR<0.05 (BH-corrected within cluster).
forest: Forest plot of top 10 significantly DE genes (FDR<0.05). Pool diamond (red) reflects mixed-model coefficient (k=2 pair + 8 baseline studies).
ma: MA plot. loess smooth (dashed blue) shows absence of mean-effect-size trend; horizontal alignment confirms TMM normalization adequacy in upstream Layer A.
top_gene_table: Top 25 differentially expressed genes (FDR<0.05, ranked by |logFC|). Full table in top_genes.csv.
heatmap: Heatmap of top 25 DE genes (rows) across samples (columns). vst + ComBat batch correction applied for visual cross-study coherence; effect-size statistics in pooled output are NOT batch-corrected.
heterogeneity: Heterogeneity panel N/A for non-REM methods (method=mega_aug); per-gene tau^2 not estimable in mixed-model framework (mega) or pair-only design (mega_aug).
